text_block_list.text:
After our outing, the two of us came to an 
amusement park. Eishin Flash said she 
wanted to use the admission tickets she 
got from a friend.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"An amusement park at night—how 
refreshing. Attractions illuminated by 
neon lights... It's truly a fantastical 
view."
choice_data_list: This is so exciting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It feels like we're going to have a 
very fun time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even so, time is limited. I've made a 
strict schedule, so let's make our way 
through the attractions in order.

And so, following Eishin Flash's 
itinerary, we headed to the roller coaster 
first—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—At this pace, we'll reach maximum 
altitude in 7 seconds. After that, we'll 
be going into a steep dive all at once."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah—it's zero!

...After that, we continued touring 
various attractions—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――Now then. Finished the teacups and the 
Ferris wheel. Next is the free fall――
choice_data_list: What about the haunted house over there?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...That place isn't in our plans.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Because zombies might show up.

—Regardless, the fun time passed by as 
planned.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, shall we go look at 
souvenirs? We need to pick something out 
for Falcon-san too."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The concession stand is... over there. 
Let's finish our purchases by 19:20 and 
exit the amusement park by 19:30.
...And so, heading over to the shop stand—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I-Is this... a German fair?

By coincidence, the souvenir shop was 
holding a Germany-themed fair.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah, this is... Donauwelle, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Is that a German sweet too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. "Welle" means "ripples" or "waves"... 
See, the chocolate on the surface is 
shaped like little waves.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I definitely recommend this one. As a cake 
shop daughter, I kinda want to check out 
the flavor for myself, too...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could that over there be... 
Streuselkuchen, and Lebkuchen...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... They have a wonderful 
selection of general goods too. These 
aren't factory-made. Most likely, they're 
handcrafted by a meister—

"...And right then, glancing at my watch, 
it was precisely 19:20, the scheduled 
time."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Look, Trainer. These are called 
Hummel figurines, you know.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We've had that on display at my family's 
shop ever since I was a kid, too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's kept on the shelf immediately to the 
left as you walk in. A small doll of a 
girl holding a little lamb—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm starting to remember. When I was 
little, I used it to play with dolls and 
got scolded for it... Hehe—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. I never imagined I'd be blessed 
with an opportunity to be reminded of my 
homeland here—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...? What is this sound...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Gasp!? Shoot... the time...!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry...! I got so carried 
away... that I threw off our whole 
schedule...!
choice_data_list:
...Just for today, that was the right 
call.

...Just for today, that might be the right 
answer.

Since we're here, why not stick around and 
look a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry...! I got so carried 
away... that I threw off our whole 
schedule...!
choice_data_list:
...Just for today, that was the right 
call.

...Just for today, that might be the right 
answer.

Since we're here, why not stick around and 
look a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
If you were able to be that absorbed in 
it...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes... It truly brought back memories 
of my hometown... I had a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, forgetting the scheduled time is 
solely due to my own immaturity... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I've decided. From now on, I'll leave 
plenty of buffer room in my schedule 
whenever I go out."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Just in case I end up having so much fun 
that I lose track of time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to enjoy fun times like 
today—to the absolute fullest, without any 
lingering worries.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
N-No, if we do that, the schedule will get 
even more messed up...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A-An unexpected mishap, you say...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, adjusting the schedule to 
account for unforeseen circumstances... is 
a necessity.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――Understood. In that case, shall we 
change our plans and browse for souvenirs 
a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Please let me immerse myself in 
memories of my homeland for a little while 
longer."

Afterward. Loaded up with plenty of 
souvenirs, I headed back home with Eishin 
Flash.
